jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
Food, people and the planet are at the heart of everything we do. Through our technologies and services, we help customers produce safe food in a sustainable and efficient way.
Within Tetra Pak Key Components, we are now looking for an Operations Manager – Separation to lead our operational organization and drive performance across Application Engineering, Order Engineering, Product Support, Technical Issue Management and operational excellence activities.
Reporting to the Manager Separation, you will lead a team that ensure efficient execution and high-quality support throughout the product lifecycle. You will be instrumental in creating a responsive, efficient and customer-focused organization.
The position is permanent and preferably based in Lund, Sweden. Some international travel may be required.
What you will do
As Operations Manager, you will lead the organization responsible for operational performance within the separation business. Your focus will be on execution, continuous improvement and customer satisfaction. Driving lead-time, forecasting and sales goals.
Main responsibilities:
Lead, coach and develop teams within Application Engineering, Order Engineering, Product Support and Technical Issue Management.
Ensure efficient execution of customer order fulfillment and support activities.
Secure that application know-how is effectively translated into customer solutions, operational excellence and business results.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase productivity, quality and responsiveness.
Lead technical issue management and support escalation handling.
Collaborate closely with customers, Sales, Services, Product Management, Supply Chain and Manufacturing.
Drive operational planning, capacity management and resource allocation.
Develop and continuously improve processes, tools and ways of working.
Monitor, analyse and improve operational performance and key business metrics.
Foster a culture focused on customer success, accountability and teamwork.
Manage departmental objectives, resources and budgets.

As a member of the Separation leadership team, you will contribute to both operational and strategic decisions affecting the business.
We believe you have
Proven leadership experience in operations, engineering, application support, technical support, service or manufacturing environments.
Experience leading customer-facing technical organizations.
Strong business understanding and operational mindset.
Experience driving performance improvements, change initiatives and organizational development.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across functions, regions and organizational levels.
Experience interacting with customers and translating customer needs into operational priorities.
Strong analytical skills.
Decisive decision making.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

You are a leader who creates structure, alignment and results. You enjoy solving complex challenges and building high-performing teams that consistently deliver to customers and stakeholders.
You thrive in an international and dynamic environment where operational excellence and people leadership go hand in hand. Through strong stakeholder management, engagement and collaboration, you create the conditions for sustainable performance and long-term success.
We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

At Electrolux Professional Group we hire to meet needs beyond tomorrow! 
UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL  
At Electrolux Professional Group, we believe potential powers progress. We’re not searching for perfection—we’re looking for people with the right mindset. If you're curious, resilient, and ready to grow, you'll find the space to lead, innovate, and together with us Meet the needs beyond tomorrow. Read more about us here: https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/join-us/ 
HEAD OF IT PRODUCT MANAGEMENT 
As Head of IT Product Management, you will accelerate innovation by connecting product data, engineering capabilities, and business needs across the entire product lifecycle.
As we implement a modern product-centric operating model, you will play a key role from the start, helping build the technology foundation that enables efficient product development, regulatory compliance, and sustainable business growth.
Are you ready for this journey?
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 
As Head of IT Product Management you own the IT Product Management domain and are responsible for the strategy, portfolio, roadmap, and performance of the solutions supporting Product Lifecycle & Data, R&D & Engineering Applications, Product Configuration, and Compliance & Documentation.
Leading a team of five, you will define the domain strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, ensuring technology drives innovation, efficiency, and business value. Working closely with business leaders, engineers, architects, and external partners, the role ensures that product development, engineering, and product data capabilities are aligned and integrated to support efficient end-to-end business processes.
Your key responsibilities:
Domain Strategy & Leadership: Own the Product Management domain strategy, roadmap, investments, KPIs, and financial performance, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivering measurable business value, innovation, and sustainable growth.
Product Portfolio & Roadmap Ownership: Lead the Product Management portfolio and roadmap, ensuring strategic investments, sustainable technology decisions, and the transition from project-based delivery to long-term product and capability ownership.
Business Partnership & Value Realization: Act as a strategic partner to business leaders and key stakeholders, driving value realization through aligned priorities, clear roadmaps, and technology-enabled business improvements.
Product Lifecycle & Capability Development: Lead the development and continuous improvement of product lifecycle systems, product data, and engineering applications to support efficient, scalable, and compliant business operations.
Delivery & Product Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Product Management organization by establishing clear accountability, aligned priorities, and effective ways of working that enable cross-functional teams to deliver business value, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Architecture, Integration & Data Alignment: Ensure domain solutions align with enterprise architecture, integration and data standards, supporting scalable, simplified end-to-end processes while coordinating dependencies across connected business and technology domains.
Operational Health & Lifecycle Management: Ensure the operational health, performance, security, and continuous evolution of the Product Management domain by balancing innovation, lifecycle management, technical sustainability, and service excellence while delivering measurable business value.

WHAT’S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Product Management, or a related field or equivalent relevant work experience.
Experience leading enterprise applications, digital products, business capabilities, or technology-enabled transformation within a complex global organization.
Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, business cases, and investment priorities, while managing application portfolios, vendors, budgets, and delivery dependencies.
Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, engineering, manufacturing, product data, and related business processes; experience with PLM, PDM, ERP, or product information platforms is an advantage.
Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams across business and IT, establishing clear ownership, governance, and accountability.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology decisions to measurable business outcomes.
Excellent prioritization, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to create clarity and drive results in complex, matrixed environments.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

 
To be eligible for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in Sweden. We are unable to offer work permit sponsorship.  
OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES    
Be Customer Obsessed. Build Trust. Be Bold. Act Sustainably. We’re building it every day — and we’d love your help.   
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU  
Trust, ownership, and the opportunity to grow! Be part of a company grounded in customer focus, sustainability leadership, innovation, and social impact.  
We aim to Meet Needs Beyond Tomorrow!  
Some of our benefits:   
Occupational pension plan  
Collective agreement  
Lunch benefits  
Massage at the office at discounted price  
Wellness allowance  
Beniflex (discounts on purchases)  
Parental leave benefits

Join our team as a Docking and Project Superintendent, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth planning and execution of dry-docking operations for Stena Line’s vessels!
 
 
In this role, you will utilize your maritime expertise to provide guidance to our Fleet Groups, ensuring adherence to docking policies and procedures while prioritizing quality, time efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also coordinate fleet and group projects under the direction of Senior Management, while also ensuring vessel accreditation to meet international safety and pollution prevention standards. If you're driven by excellence and adept at optimizing operations, apply now to be part of our team!
 
 
Some of your key responsibilities: 
 
- Manage and coordinate dry-docking processes.
 
- Review and standardize docking and repair specifications.
 
- Coordinate refit budgeting and cost analysis with Fleet Group.
 
- Manage pre-docking planning and reporting.
 
- Act as Project Manager for technical projects.
 
- Monitor project risks and key milestones.
 
- Negotiate terms with ship repair yards.
 
- Ensure efficient vessel management during refits.
 
- Maintain vessel standards and appearance.
 
- Provide expertise to Fleet Group and Company management.
 
- Assist with warranty claims and post-project evaluations. 
 
- Ensure compliance with contractual and commercial agreements.
 
- Liaise with departments supporting vessels.
 
- Travel as required. 
 
 
What you will experience
 
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
 
 
Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of colleagues.
 
 
Who are you?
 
At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.
 
 
We believe you are a team-player who thrives in a collaborative environment. You share your knowledge and pay attention to the details in everything you do. We also believe you welcome new challenges with an open, and positive attitude.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
- Unlimited Chief Engineer or Master certification. Alternatively, a degree in nautical science-related fields.
 
- Practical experience either onboard with exposure to onboard management teams or a minimum of 1+ year experience ashore in technical/project roles within a shipping company's operations.
 
- Keen knowledge of vessel operations, and technical and safety requirements for RoPax-type vessels. 
 
- Dry-dock planning and planned maintenance systems. 
 
- Financial knowledge of budgets and cost control to ensure effective project management whilst maintaining company standards of safety and quality.
 
- Strong understanding of the key concepts of Health and Safety  
 
- Knowledge of ISM and ISO standards and codes
 
 
Interested? 
 
This is a full-time, permanent position based in Gothenburg within our Fleet Operations department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than 1 December, 2026. We are having an ongoing selection, so do not wait with your application. To ensure the secure and structured processing of your personal data, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. 
 
 
We have collective bargaining agreements with Unionen, among others, who you can contact for more information. Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment. We may conduct background checks as part of our efforts to ensure the quality of our recruitment process.
 
 
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Hans Corneliusson, Group Head of Fleet Support, hans.corneliusson@stenaline.com or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hedwig.blixt@stenaline.com.
 
 
About Stena Line
 
As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe’s most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.
 
 
Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Business Manager - E2E.
Your role and responsibilities 
At Metallurgy Products, we develop, manufacture, and deliver electromagnetic stirrers that help customers improve metal quality, process efficiency, and sustainability. Our solutions are used by leading companies in the global steel and aluminum industry. As a global business unit, we combine world-class engineering with our own workshop and production facilities in Västerås, Sweden. This allows us to take full responsibility for the entire value chain, from design and manufacturing to installation and commissioning. Our work extends far beyond the factory floor. Through international projects, site assignments, and customer collaborations across the globe, we help shape the future of the metals industry while delivering innovative solutions to customers worldwide. Joining Metallurgy Products means becoming part of an international team where technology, craftsmanship, and customer focus come together to create tangible value for the world's leading steel and aluminum producers.
Your responsibilities
Drive and continuously improve HSE processes, plans and ways of working.
Support managers, project teams and operational personnel in risk assessments, incident investigations and preventive actions.
Ensure compliance with ABB requirements, legal obligations and internal management standards.
Lead HSE reporting, KPI follow-up and documentation, ensuring activities are completed and properly evidenced.
Promote a proactive culture where hazards, risks and improvement opportunities are identified and addressed.
Support site activities, installation and commissioning phases from an HSE perspective.
Coordinate quality governance activities, including ISO management systems, audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to the development of the function towards a broader HSEQ framework.

Qualifications
Proven experience in HSE within manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering or project environments.
Strong understanding of risk management, compliance, reporting and management systems.
Experience working with audits, ISO standards and quality processes is highly valued.
A hands-on and structured approach, with the ability to work independently and drive activities to completion.
Comfortable working with documentation, KPIs, databases and reporting tools.
Experience from an international and matrix-organized environment is an advantage.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Why ABB Metallurgy?
This role offers a unique opportunity to make a visible impact across manufacturing, operations and global projects. You will join a collaborative team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do, while helping shape the future development of our HSEQ capabilities. 
What’s in it for you?
We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. 
More about us
We look forward to reading your application in PDF format. Please note that the interview process is ongoing, apply now to secure your spot in the recruitment process!  
Please note that to be eligible for employment at ABB Sweden, you will need to pass our pre-employment screening steps. This includes a reference check, a drug test, and could also include an extended background check.  
We kindly decline direct contact with staffing and recruitment agencies as well as sellers of additional job advertisements.  
Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World. 
Recruiting Manager, Ola Norén, +46 70 520 51 10 will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Blomqvist, +4621 34 21 48; Ledarna: Leif Öhrberg, +4621 34 23 25; Unionen: Krista Andersson, +4621 34 02 85. All other questions can be directed to Talent Partner Sara Vestin, +46 72 4644688
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Lead and shape People Operations at our Rosersberg site - driving operational excellence, employee experience, and strong labor relations in a fast-growing circular economy.
Balance leadership, labour law, and staffing while driving efficient HR processes for Sellpy Operations. From coaching to strategic site development, lead our local HR team and build a safe workplace.
Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We see a tremendous financial, social and environmental value in making sure unused items are put to use again. We are looking for colleagues who share this vision, and who are ready to see their work contribute to a sustainable future.
HR Manager Interim, at Sellpy
We’re looking for a grounded, operational HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced logistics environment and is passionate about driving a modern, proactive People Operations function. In this interim role, you will take full ownership of leading and developing our local HR function at the site in Rosersberg. You will act as a trusted advisor to our Site Manager and local management, ensuring our site meets staffing targets while fostering a safe, empowered, and sustainable work environment.
You will dive into labor law - specifically Lager- och e-handelsavtalet - manage union relations, and streamline everything from recruitment to on- and offboarding journeys. Together with the site management, you'll balance day-to-day coaching with continuous improvement projects that boost site performance and scalability.
In short, you will
Provide first-line leadership support and coaching to managers across daily employee relations and operational challenges.
Lead, coach, and develop the local HR team at our Rosersberg site. The team consists of one HR Generalist and one Recruiter.
Drive staffing strategies to meet operational targets, balancing direct warehouse recruitment and temporary agency staffing.
Manage labour relations, acting as the primary point of contact for collective bargaining agreements (Lager- och e-handelsavtalet), union collaboration, safety delegates, and occupational health services.
Oversee systematic work environment management (SAM) in close partnership with the Site Manager to ensure a secure and healthy workplace.
Manage authority liaise with relevant agencies and handle work permit applications with Migrationsverket when needed.
Build, optimise, and maintain smooth employee journeys, from onboarding and offboarding to HR system administration and payroll preparations.

We use
Modern HRM and ATS platforms for end-to-end People Operations and recruitment tracking
Google Workspace and collaborative communication tools

Requirements
A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, Behavioral science, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in an HR Manager role (2+ years) or HRBP role (3+ years) within logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, or a fast-paced operational setting.
Solid working knowledge of Swedish labor law (arbetsrätt) and practical experience with Swedish collective agreements, preferably Lager- och e-handelsavtalet.
Experience leading or mentoring HR team members and collaborating constructively with trade unions and safety representatives.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to balance hands-on operational duties and structured process improvements.
Pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with high personal integrity and communication skills.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

We’d be impressed if you have
Experience managing temporary staffing agencies and high-volume blue-collar recruitment.
Worked in a fast-growing, product-focused startup or scale-up environment.
Prior experience handling work permit applications with Migrationsverket.

You get to
Work closely with production and operations, experiencing firsthand the heartbeat of our circular supply chain.
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues.
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform
Make use of prepaid vacation
Enjoy Sellpy credits and staff discounts at Sellpy
Save up with a monthly pension plan
Engagement in Sellpy’s social traditions with game nights, interactive planning days, guest speakers and other activities

Location
On-site at our warehouse in Rosersberg.
Due to the operational nature of this role and the need to stay closely connected with the warehouse team and managers, you will spend the majority of your time on-site. You will have regular touchpoints and collaboration with our HQ in Stockholm.
Form of employment: Full-time (Interim)
Start: Mid March 2027 to approximately April 2028
How we use AI
We may use AI as part of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by humans.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 
As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. 
 
About the job 
As s Customer Quality Specialist you will own and drive the end-to-end customer claims process across our business unit. This means ensuring timely resolution of customer quality issues, reduction of claim costs, prevention of recurrence, and continuous improvement of customer satisfaction. 
You will lead the end-to-end customer claims process and work cross-functionally to improve customer experience, strengthen quality performance, and drive sustainable business improvements. 
 
The role has cross-functional exposure and you will work closely with Operations, Product & Portfolio Management, R&D / Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, Service, and Quality. 
 
Key responsibilities: 
Ownership of the end-to-end customer claims process towards full portfolio. 
Standardize claim management practices across the BU. 
Strengthen cross-functional accountability for corrective actions. 
Increase customer confidence through proactive claim and escalation management 
Follow up on claims and quality situations by making statistics, analysis and creating claims and quality reports. 
Drive and manage quality improvement projects/activities. 

 
Long term goals will be: 
Reduce customer claim costs and quality-related business risks and enable leadership to focus on strategic priorities rather than operational intervention. 
Drive systemic quality improvements through trend analysis and prevention. 
Establish a scalable and sustainable claims management framework. 

 
Networking and stakeholder engagement are important aspects of this role, which includes occasional domestic and international travel. You will be part of a team of three and report to Kubra Kucuk, who leads with trust, welcome creativity and are open to ideas to continuously develop our ways of working. 
 
Who are you 
We are looking for you with a commercial mindset who is proactive, structured and have a curious mind to constantly find ways forward, driving for solutions and gaining results. This is not only an administrative role - but you will also have a big impact on business and customer satisfaction. The scope of this role is broad and diverse, requiring the ability to effectively prioritize competing demands while remaining resilient in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. 
If you enjoy engaging with people, building strong stakeholder relationships, and working in a global environment, you will thrive in this role. 

 
What you know 
This is a role for you with some experience of process ownership in a similar role and who are used to stakeholder management in a larger, preferably international cross-functional environment. 
Requirements: 
Work experience in Quality, Customer Quality, Customer Claims, Manufacturing Quality, or a similar role. 
Root cause analysis and problem solving (8D, 5 Why, CAPA). 
Experience in data analysis and KPI reporting. 
Quality management systems (QMS) understanding. 
Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technical Education - mechanical/chemical/production, or a related field and/or many years of working with customer claims in for the role related field. 
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English 

Merit:
Power BI and digitalization skills 
Experience in engineered products, manufacturing, or industrial equipment. 

 
For more information, please contact 
Kubra Kucuk Aydemir, Head of Governance & QHSE, PPMI  
or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner  
We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). 
Please send your application no later than December 2, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

Our commitment to integrity 
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what concerns people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we decarbonize and replace cars.
 
 
Welder for collision damage – your next challenge in Västerås!
Are you a welder who thrives on challenges? Alstom is now looking for a new colleague who will work with repairs of damaged and crash-damaged vehicles in a dynamic and exciting environment.
 
Your future role
You will report to the Production Leader and work together with a dedicated and competent team.
The group in the workshop consists of about 12 people and is a mix of both welders/blacksmiths and modification technicians (fitters). You will get good support and support from our colleagues from other functions such as engineering, industrialisation engineering, quality and purchasing.
In this role, you will be an important part of the problem-solving process and we are looking for someone who has a passion for finding effective solutions. Your creativity and initiative are crucial to our daily work.
 
The position includes, among other things:
Replacing and aligning body parts
Welding, gluing and riveting
Disassembling and assembling vehicles

 
You will work with both black and stainless steel as well as aluminum. We would like you to have a few years of experience in welding and be able to read drawings.
 
Who are you?
We value passion and attitude over experience. We don't expect you to have all the skills, but we believe that the following skills will help you succeed and grow in this role:
 
Relevant education or experience in welding
Previous work with welding and repair of vehicles or similar industries
Good knowledge of Black MAG (145 2-12mm) and Stainless Steel MAG (145 2-12mm) to ensure high quality and efficiency in the work
Knowledge of drawing reading and technical specifications related to welding
Worked with welding that has requirements for non-destructive testing, such as Visual Inspection, Penetrant or Magnetic Powder.
Be able to communicate freely in Swedish and good knowledge of English

 
Qualifications:
Welding certificate
Post-Weld Direction
Alu MIG (141 2-12mm), TIG (141) and pin welding (131/111)
Heat direction/cold direction of bumps

 
We value the following personal qualities in you:
Creativity: You have the ability to think outside the box, which helps us find new and innovative solutions to welding-related problems.
Solution-oriented: You quickly identify welding challenges and address them effectively, which is important for keeping our projects on track.
Collaboration-oriented: Your unpretentious approach lifts collaboration in the team and creates a positive work environment where we achieve common goals.

 
The work is carried out during the day, but you should be open to being able to work shifts.
This service requires you to undergo a medical examination, which Alstom will provide.
 
Interviews take place on an ongoing basis, so send in your application today.
 
Things you'll like
Join us on a lifelong transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, allowing you to grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.
 
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career that is free from boring daily routines.
Working with the latest safety standards for the railway industry
Contributing to innovative projects
Steer your career in any direction you want across functions and countries
Leverage our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

Job description:   Do you want to help shape the next generation of automation solutions for the mining industry? As a Product Owner within Surface Automation, you will play a key role in translating product strategy and customer needs into clear priorities and tangible results together with our development teams.  Join Our Team
 You will become part of Surface Software Engineering, where we develop advanced automation solutions for Epiroc’s surface products. Here, we work across teams, functions, and countries, bringing together diverse perspectives to create solutions that deliver real value to our customers.
  
 Your Mission
 As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating the agreed roadmap, Epics, and objectives into clear team goals and a prioritized backlog. You will represent customer and business value throughout the development process and help the team stay focused on what creates the greatest impact. In this role, you will: 
 Own and continuously prioritize the team’s backlog based on customer and business value.
   
Translate roadmaps, Epics, and objectives into clear priorities, scope, and team goals. 
 
    
Balance new functionality with quality, technical debt, maintenance, security, and risk reduction. 
 
    
Follow development progress and deliveries together with the team, ensuring up-to-date forecasts for Epics and features. 
 
    
Validate outcomes, gather feedback early, and use insights to adjust priorities. 
 
    
Coordinate priorities, dependencies, and releases together with other Product Owners and relevant stakeholders.
 
  
Your ProfileWe are looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer, business, and technology. You create structure and clarity even when circumstances change, and you are comfortable making decisions and balancing competing priorities. At the same time, you are a good listener who builds trust through close collaboration with development teams, Product Management, and other stakeholders. To succeed in this role, we believe you have: 
   
Experience working as a Product Owner, in agile product development, or in a similar role within software, automation, or complex technical systems. 
 
    
The ability to understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear objectives and priorities for development teams. 
 
    
Strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment, prioritize among competing demands, and drive initiatives to decisions-making.
 
    
Fluency in English is required, both written and verbally 
 
  
 
 You do not need to be the person defining the technical solution yourself. You will work closely with developers, architects, and other technical experts who contribute feasibility assessments, estimates, risk analyses, and solution decisions. Your strength lies in creating clarity around needs, value, and priorities. Experience with industrial automation, autonomous solutions, mining operations, or other safety-critical and complex products is considered an advantage.
 Location and TravelThis position is based in Örebro, Sweden. Travel may be required when needed.
  
 In addition to a culture characterized by growth and development combined with a healthy work-life balance, there are a few things that make us especially proud to work at Epiroc:
  Global career opportunities.
 Epiroc University for your ongoing professional development.
 Community engagement.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

Business development, innovation or project management.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

jobs.occupation: Junior Structural Analysis Engineer – Marine Technology
jobs.description:
Work with large-scale moving structures where structural analysis, advanced mechanics and material engineering come together. Help develop innovative wind-powered technology for more energy-efficient shipping, taking your calculations and design solutions all the way to full-scale applications. As part of a small engineering team, you'll have the freedom to influence the product and take ownership from day one. Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, you'll get to tackle complex engineering challenges while developing your technical expertise.
About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Structural Analysis Engineer to join an innovative technology company in Stockholm, developing large-scale mechanical systems for more sustainable shipping. The company combines advanced engineering, mechanical design and material technology to create solutions that harness wind power and reduce fuel consumption in the maritime industry.
In this role, you will focus on developing and improving existing products, making complex mechanical structures lighter, more efficient and easier to manufacture. Your work will range from detailed structural calculations and smaller design improvements to evaluating major design changes and new technical concepts.
You will work closely with mechanical engineers and other specialists in a small, collaborative development team. The products involve large moving structures exposed to demanding environmental conditions, where loads, movement, material properties and mechanical functionality must all be considered.
What makes this opportunity particularly exciting is the ability to influence the actual product. Your calculations and technical assessments will directly contribute to design decisions, and you will have the opportunity to follow your work through development, manufacturing and testing. With a high level of responsibility and freedom, you will play an active role in shaping both the technical solutions and the final product.
Key Responsibilities
Perform structural calculations and analyses of large-scale mechanical structures and components.
Analyze and optimize designs with regard to strength, weight, functionality and manufacturability.
Evaluate how different loads, movements and material properties affect structural performance.
Prepare calculation reports and technical documentation to support engineering decisions.
Work with calculation and simulation tools, including opportunities to develop and improve analysis methods.
Evaluate design alternatives and contribute to technical solutions in close collaboration with mechanical engineers.
Participate in product development, from early concepts and design iterations to final solutions and testing.

About You
A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Engineering Mechanics, Marine Engineering or a related field.
A solid understanding of structural mechanics, strength of materials and mechanical behavior under different loads.
Experience with structural calculations and analysis, gained through academic projects or professional work.
An interest in mechanical design and understanding how individual components contribute to the performance of a complete system.
Good communication skills in English.

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with finite element analysis (FEA), ANSYS, Python or similar engineering calculation tools. Experience with large mechanical structures, moving systems, hydraulics, steel or composite materials is also valuable. A background in marine engineering, offshore, heavy industry or working with DNV standards would be particularly relevant.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and comfortable taking responsibility for your own work. You enjoy getting into the technical details of calculations while maintaining an understanding of the bigger picture. You take initiative, explore different solutions and are motivated by seeing your engineering work turn into real, functioning products.
About the employment
This is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and our client is for you to transition to direct employment with the client after 12 months.
Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.
Practical information
Employment: Full-time
Start date: By agreement
Location: Stockholm, Flemmingsberg
Salary: Market-aligned monthly salary
Contact person: Anna Persson

Friday connects technical specialists with companies where their knowledge and ambitions can develop over time. We take the time to understand what you are looking for and match you with roles that fit both your experience and your next career step.
We value potential and ambition and work actively toward an inclusive recruitment process in which candidates are assessed on relevant qualifications and experience.
Friday has offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Each year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and recruit technical specialists for organisations ranging from international companies to growing technology businesses.

MAXI-PRESS is looking for a Technical Sales and Service Representative to support and develop its business across Sweden and the wider Scandinavian market.
This is a varied and independent position for someone with experience from a technical industrial environment who would like to combine field service, installation and customer-focused technical sales.
About the company
MAXI-PRESS is a German company that has developed, manufactured and supplied spare parts, wear parts and consumables for industrial laundries since 2006. Its product portfolio supports machinery from a wide range of manufacturers and helps customers maintain reliable and efficient production.
The range includes membranes, ironer padding, conveyor belts and numerous other specialist components, spare parts and consumables for industrial laundry equipment.
MAXI-PRESS became part of the JENSEN-GROUP in 2024 while continuing to operate under its established brand. The business is now entering an exciting phase of growth and is looking to strengthen its presence across Sweden and Scandinavia.
About the role
As a Technical Sales and Service Representative, you will become an important customer-facing representative of MAXI-PRESS in Scandinavia. The role combines practical technical work with sales and the development of existing customer relationships.
Initially, the position will have a strong technical focus. You will visit industrial laundries to carry out installations, light maintenance and the replacement of wear and spare parts. This may include installing ironer padding, replacing conveyor belts and identifying requirements for spare parts and consumables.
Working directly at customer sites will give you a natural opportunity to understand each customer’s machinery, operations and future requirements. The commercial side of the role is therefore focused on developing existing relationships and recommending relevant technical solutions rather than traditional cold-call sales.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Carrying out light technical maintenance and installations at customer sites
Installing and replacing ironer padding, conveyor belts and other wear parts
Identifying customer requirements for spare parts and consumables
Developing and maintaining long-term customer relationships
Providing technical advice and recommending suitable products
Preparing quotations and following up on sales opportunities
Planning customer visits and independently organising your working week
Working closely with technical specialists and colleagues within MAXI-PRESS and the JENSEN-GROUP
Supporting the continued growth of MAXI-PRESS across Sweden and Scandinavia

This is a home-based position involving extensive travel, primarily by car. You will mainly support customers in southern Sweden, Denmark and parts of Norway. Approximately 75 per cent of the role may involve travel, including regular overnight stays.
We are therefore primarily looking for someone based in southern Sweden, preferably in Skåne or within the area extending from Gothenburg southwards. Your exact location will affect how frequently customer visits can be completed as day trips.
We are looking for someone who
Has approximately three to five years of experience in an industrial technical, maintenance, service or spare-parts role
Has practical experience with industrial machinery and is comfortable working in production or factory environments
Has a genuine interest in technology and enjoys hands-on technical work
Has customer-facing experience and the ability to build trusted professional relationships
Can independently organise, plan and manage their work
Is comfortable with extensive travel and regular overnight stays
Holds a valid driving licence
Is fluent in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:
Spare parts, wear parts or technical consumables
Preventive maintenance or technical field service
Food production, process industries, marine engineering or other machinery-intensive environments
Industrial laundries, ironers, conveyor belts or laundry machinery
Technical sales, quotations and consultative customer support
Danish, Norwegian, Finnish or German language skills

The opportunity
Do you want to work in a future-focused industry where technology meets sustainability? Do you thrive in an environment where you can grow and make a real difference?
We are looking for an enthusiastic, flexible and curious Senior Relay Engineer to join our engineering team at Grid Automation Sweden. This is an opportunity to use your protection engineering expertise in meaningful substation automation projects while helping us shape the next generation of digital solutions. If you understand IEC 61850-based systems and are motivated by turning new technology into practical, reliable ways of working, you can make a real difference in our team.
In this role, you will work with relay protection and system integration across our substation projects. You will have the freedom to bring ideas, challenge established approaches and help develop smarter and more efficient ways of working as we expand our substation capabilities. At the same time, you will grow through close collaboration with colleagues across protection, SCADA, communication and design, and become part of our world-class Hub Europe engineering community with extensive experience in delivering large and complex substation automation projects globally.
You will be part of an inclusive and innovative workplace where collaboration, learning, and development are part of everyday work, and where flexible ways of working support your work–life balance.
How you will make an impact
You will be involved in developing protection and control concepts for sub-transmission systems in close collaboration with the customer along with the project core team.
You will be responsible for the configuration and testing of the relay system.
Open-minded team player that looks for opportunities instead of problems and has high standards towards safety, quality, customer focus, and efficiency.
You will openly share ideas and lessons learned with colleagues and curiously seek improvements.
Living Hitachi energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
You hold a bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent experience.
Several years of experience from Transmission and Distribution projects.
Worked with the configuration and testing of IED’s from different suppliers.
Structured and pro-active engineering approach, with a high commitment towards maintaining project budget and project plan.
For this position, professional proficiency in spoken and written English is required. Basic spoken and written Swedish skills are also required. Strong verbal and written communication skills in Swedish are considered an advantage.

 
More About Us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual, fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
About the Apps Platform
The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
The Apps Platform is growing fast, and we're investing heavily in each layer of the stack — building deeper ownership over the services that power our users' apps so we can move faster, scale better, and shape the product experience us and our users actually want.
The Role
We’re looking for software engineers with a platform mindset to work on the app runtime, deployment pipeline, and the composable managed services we purchase and operate. Some foundational services we buy from 3p partners, others are not available for purchase and you would be the first in the world to build them at scale. You'll keep these services running reliably, manage vendor relationships and migrations, and ensure operational excellence across the stack.
What You'll Do
Own the app hosting and deployment pipeline — the runtime that serves user applications in production
Manage and operate composable managed services for storage, logging, workflows etc
Build and maintain custom domains infrastructure, ensuring reliable SSL provisioning and DNS management at scale
Drive vendor evaluation, onboarding, and migration as we continue decomposing our platform from a bundled BaaS to best-of-breed individual services
Establish operational excellence practices: monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks, and capacity planning across all managed services

What We're Looking For
Experience building and operating distributed systems
Ideally 6+ years of experience in running and developing
Strong background in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure operations
Deep understanding of multitenant app hosting infrastructure, container orchestration, or edge runtimes
Vendor management experience: evaluating services, negotiating contracts, planning migrations, and holding vendors accountable for SLAs
Operational mindset: you think in uptime, latency percentiles, cost-per-request, and blast radius

Nice to Have
Experience building and operating massively multitenant control planes
Experience operating Cloudflare Workers, Pages, R2, or D1 at scale
Hands on experience contribution to cloud infrastructure or CNCF projects (kubernetes, worked, envoy)
Familiarity with ClickHouse or other columnar databases for log analytics
Experience with managed database services (such as Supabase, Neon, AWS Aurora, Google Cloud SQL etc)
Cost optimization experience — you've driven meaningful infrastructure cost reduction

Our tech stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
Frontend: React and Typescript.
Backend: Golang and Rust.
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS.
Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.
DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform.

And always on the lookout for what's next!

jobs.occupation: Process / Production Engineer to Automotive Company
jobs.description:
Do you have experience as a Process Engineer and / or as a Production Engineer and want to become a part of a world leading company? In this position you will be given the chance to join a passionate team working in a multicultural, open and dynamic environment.
ABOUT THE POSITION:
The job as Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is exciting and often rewarding, working for the benefit of the Customer Satisfaction, in contact with multiple internal and external stakeholders. We are looking for someone who has experience as a Process Engineer and / or Production Engineer who wants to take the next step in their career as a Supplier Quality Engineer.
This position belongs to the Chassis team but is in interaction with the full organisation. You will join a passionate team working in a multicultural, open and dynamic environment, eager to develop and improve with all of our stakeholders, internal and external, in order to ensure the best quality of their products.
The main focus of the team is on performance, both on supplier results and its own efficiency. Opportunities exist for the SQE to attend internal continuous improvement activities aiming for leaner working processes. From the sourcing stage up to the running production, the main tasks assigned to the Surface treatment SQE are:
To evaluate Surface Treatment (coating on Metal / Plastics ) supplier lines and facilities, managing their development plan up to the excellence level required by our customers standards.
To support the new part developments, securing the suppliers ability to coat the parts according to the specification on robust manufacturing processes.
To lead the supplier continuous improvements as well as being entitled to steer strong reaction in case of supplier performance deviation.
To contribute to the Surface Treatment Supplier Quality Global Network, working on new standard inputs, continuously improving the assessment tool and permanently monitoring the next technology and their opportunities.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
The must-haves:
Preferred Academic Degree about Surface Treatment Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering or Electrochemical Engineering, or Polymer Engineering organic and/or inorganic coating area or:
An extensive experience and strong performance in the Surface Treatment field can substitute for academic degree.
Experience as a Process Engineer and / or Production Engineer.
Has the ability to travel for work.
Are fluent in English and Swedish both spoken and written because the languages is spoken internally/externally.

The nice-to-haves:
Experience upon the Surface Treatment (coating) application processes/troubleshooting and its management within automotive business is a plus.
Good knowledge and practice of automotive quality standards and tools, such as IATF 16949, APQP-PPAP, process audit, special process audits Eg. CQI 11/12 and problem solving.

A great emphasis will be put on personal attributes where we are looking for someone that is curious, driven and has passion to be part of our clients target to shape the future of transportation and its supply chain. We also believe that you are a true team player with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with your counterparts. Furthermore, you have a quality mindset and are interested in developing suppliers; you demonstrate excellent communication skills, and you are comfortable in cross functional and multicultural set-up.
ABOUT THE ASSIGNMENT:
This is a consulting assignment which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The ambition from the client and Friday is that the assignment will result in a permanent position.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
Employment type: Full time
Location: Gothenburg
Point of contact: Hanna Andersson
Salary: Fixed monthly salary

Apply by clicking "Sök tjänst". Remember to be quick with your application as we make continuous selection of candidates, and the position can be filled before the application deadline is due.
ABOUT FRIDAY:
At Friday, we are passionate about giving you, as a tech talent, a great start to your career. By listening to what motivates you and what you are looking for, we match you with companies and opportunities that make you look forward to going to work.
We highly value ambition and potential, and actively work towards an unbiased recruitment process where everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed.
We are located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Every year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and match candidates with everything from global companies to innovative start-ups.

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join us as a Sales Manager, where you will take the lead in selling and managing complex Service Agreements and Operating & Maintenance contracts for Medium Gas Turbines to our global customers. We call it Long Term Programs (LPT). You will collaborate closely with regional sales managers and coordinate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, finance, execution, legal, and new unit sales across Siemens Energy’s global organization. From the initiation of contracts to their closure and celebration, you will play a pivotal role in this process. Are you ready to embrace this unique and challenging global sales opportunity? Apply now for the Service Agreement Sales Manager position and help us shape the future of energy!
 How You’ll Make an Impact
 You will promote, negotiate, and market Service Agreements to potential customers and Siemens Energy’s worldwide sales organizations, engaging in financial modeling, risk management, legal compliance, and technical contract negotiations.
 Strategically challenge competitors by offering innovative, tailored products and solutions that meet customer needs.
 Develop winning market strategies to enhance Siemens Energy’s competitive positioning.
 You will act independently, serving as a team leader or member in various projects.
 Act as the customer’s extended arm within the organization in Finspång.
 You will lead and actively participate in customer meetings to foster strong relationships and achieve successful outcomes.
  
What You Bring
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering and/or relevant financial or legal education.
 A minimum of 3 years of experience in sales and/or engineering of complex products, preferably gas turbines, with direct customer interaction.
 A strong interest and drive to create business solutions that meet customer needs.
 Well-developed communication and presentation skills.
 A focused, organized approach, receptive to the opinions and views of others.
 Drive, energy, persistence, and the ability to inspire those around you.
 High proficiency in verbal and written communication in English, with proficiency in Swedish being a plus.
  
About the Team
We are a dynamic team of 12 members, each bringing diverse backgrounds and extensive experience in selling Long Term Programs. As we anticipate growth and prioritize proactive succession planning, we are eager to welcome new team members who can contribute to our success.
 Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
 We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
 Who is Siemens Energy?
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
